## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(scope): …`)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `clippy -D warnings`, `test` and `cargo deny check` pass
- [ ] New user-visible strings are in `locales/en.yml`
- [ ] New dependencies are the latest version, permissively licensed, and credited in `docs/CREDITS.md` if notable
- [ ] `docs/PLAN.md` updated if scope or architecture changed
